introduction: Virginia WIC provides food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support. A local clinic reviews eligibility and nutritional needs.
description: Virginia WIC provides food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support. A local clinic reviews eligibility and nutritional needs.

sections.who: Applicants must meet participant-category, residence, income and nutrition-risk rules. Qualifying groups include pregnant and postpartum participants, infants and children younger than five.
sections.get: Assigned nutritious foods are purchased with eWIC at authorized stores. Counseling and referrals are also available.
sections.docs:
• Identity and address records.
  • Income or benefit evidence requested by the clinic.
  • Pregnancy or child information for assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Apply Now on Virginia WIC, which links to myvawic.org.

  2. Arrange certification

    Ask the clinic what records to bring and who must attend.

  3. Review the package

    Staff explain the approved foods, card use and follow-up needs.
sections.after: Keep appointments and check the benefit period before shopping. An initial online request is not a completed eligibility decision.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Virginia WIC; State eligibility overview. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
